use_cases: Voice input interface for AI assistants and chatbots
Audio recording trigger for voice commands in applications
Interactive voice input for SaaS dashboards and productivity tools
Voice capture component for developer tools and IDEs
Recording interface for content creation and creator platforms
ai_summary: A minimalist voice input component featuring a central microphone button that toggles recording states. Includes a built-in timer display showing recording duration, smooth hover transitions, and supports demo animation mode for showcasing the recording interaction. Perfect for integrating voice capabilities into AI-powered applications and conversational interfaces.
